title: Centre-State administrative relations: more bodies, forces, disputes

boxes.title: Directions & delegation: more
items: National Emergency: Centre directs states on ==**any matter**==
**258(1)** notification = a **legislative act**; specific or general
Purpose of delegation: avoid **rigidity and deadlock**
⚠ UPSC notes swap headings of **258** and **258A**

boxes.title: AIS: recruitment & critique
items: **Art. 312** can create an ==**All India Judicial Service**==
**UPSC** recruits on all-India basis; Centre trains; officers serve in **state cadres**
**Unitary feature**: officers under Central rules (APPSC-G2 **2025**: A and R true, R explains A)
Cadre Rules: also without **officer** consent; Centre's order final after a set time
Suggestion: new AIS for **health and education**
AIS = same service for Union and states (PYQ **2007**)
